author: Yffe
content: Implement forge per-item content-addressed proof cache (cache.rs): cache_key = sha256 over 4 domain-tagged length-prefixed inputs (lowered Verus source + seed + verus version + thermite version); load/store under target/thermite-proof-cache/<hex>.json with atomic temp+rename and corrupt-entry-degrades-to-MISS. Wire check.rs L3 path: resolve verus version once per run (VERUS_VERSION pin else verus --version; absent => VerusAbsent, never empty key), lookup BEFORE run_verus (HIT => with_cached(true), skip verus), store after MISS (with_cached(false)). Additive manifest::Certificate.cached (serde default, oracle-excluded so a hit is oracle-equal to a fresh verify). Soundness: a hit equals a fresh verify because the key captures every verdict-determining input. Tests: HIT, decisive verus-unavailable HIT, invalidation, locality (per-item key), determinism/purity, corpus-still-L3.
